text: Traffic is prohibited on the Gudauri (Posta)-Kobi section.
Traffic is prohibited on the Gudauri (Posta)-Kobi section, according to information released by the Roads Department of the Ministry of Regional Development and Infrastructure of Georgia.
According to the information from the Roads Department, the avalanche risk level on the mentioned section is high.

"According to the Roads Department of the Ministry of Regional Development and Infrastructure of Georgia, based on information from the National Environmental Agency, the avalanche hazard level is high on the Gudauri (Posta)-Kobi section of the Mtskheta-Stepantsminda-Larsi international highway. Consequently, the movement of all types of motor vehicles is temporarily prohibited on this section."
"According to the National Environmental Agency, vehicular traffic on the Mleta-Gudauri section will proceed in a non-stop movement mode," the information states.
